content:
kai: Kicking off light bring-up for zeta3b-int4 tomorrow AM. Goal: curated promptset + golden that exercises quant artifacts + cross-model benchmark comparison.
mirella: thanks. want to keep golden small-ish (~600) but high signal across locales, code-switching, and structured inputs.
dave: agree. also need clear rollback gates for canary if crit-rate delta > 6% or BLEURT median drops > 0.04 vs zeta3b-fp16.
soph: add token-boundary stress tests + entity-preservation checks. quant tended to mangle numeric formats last cycle.
labelops-bot: LabelOps capacity: 1.4k/day. Recommend double-review for golden items. Reserve slots?
kai: reserve. plan: sample 2k candidates focused on long-tail locales + structured prompts -> dedupe -> split 600 golden / 1400 review. include adversarial 150.
mirella: dedupe policy: exact_token=0.95, semantic_cos=0.80 (embed model tok-v4). keep intent diversity by cluster.
dave: also exclude holdout lists: ["holdout_main_2025","zeta_anchor_v1"]. record exclusions in provenance.
soph: add tokenizer-variant checks (bpe vs unigram) with token-level diffs. we need counts and example diffs in the report.
eval-bot: suggested sampling config:
```
mode: focused_longtail
locales: ["pl","pt_BR","ko","en-AU","es-MX"]
min_tokens: 10
max_tokens: 2000
semantic_dedupe: 0.80
exact_dedupe: 0.95
adversarial_count: 150
golden_count: 600
labelpool_count: 1400
exclude_lists: ["holdout_main_2025","zeta_anchor_v1"]
embed_model: tok-v4-embed
normalization: nfkc+lower+trim_ws
```
labelops-bot: Golden review policy: double-review; adjudicate if disagreement >= 15%; escalate to kai if >=25%. Slots reserved starting 09:00 UTC.
kai: timeline: start 09:00 UTC tomorrow, finish +72h. canary target 2025-07-10T06:00:00Z.
dave: eval harness needs to run paired tests: zeta3b-fp16 vs int8 vs int4. metrics: crit_rate, BLEURT, exact_match, tokenizer_delta, entity_preservation_rate. compute per-locale deltas and statistical significance (bootstrap).
soph: add quant-bias checks (name replacement, numeric distortion) to harness. small systemic shifts are dealbreakers.
mirella: also include a small anchor set of 200 stable prompts (anchors) to ensure calibration. these anchors must not be in golden or label pool.
eval-bot: eval command snippet:
```
./eval/run --models zeta3b-fp16,zeta3b-int8,zeta3b-int4 --dataset s3://curation/zeta3b/micro-golden.json --metrics crit_rate,bleurt,exact_match,tokenizer_delta,entity_preserve --bootstrap=1000 --out s3://evals/zeta3b/bringup-2025-07
```
labelops-bot: Reminder: labeling budget burn rate will be reported to finance if >2k/day.
kai: noted. we'll keep within 1.4k/day.
dave: Canary rollback gate: any locale with crit-rate regression >8% OR BLEURT median drop >0.06 triggers immediate rollback and hotfix branch. also auto-fallback to int8 if available.
soph: add examples to smoke report where tokenization diffs map to different entity spans. that's been a reliable signal.
mirella: i'll prepare provenance JSON and upload seeds to s3://curation/zeta3b/bringup-2025-07 and post link here when done.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2025-07-10T06:00:00Z -> zeta3b-int4 on staging-dedicated. Notifying #eng-runtime and #eng-sre.
kai: final checklist: sampling config, dedupe lists, anchor set, labelops reserved, eval harness wired, canary scheduled. if no blockers we'll proceed. :rocket:
eval-bot: I'll post initial smoke results in this thread within 10-14h post-canary.
labelops-bot: Ack. Slots reserved and workflow created.
